feature_description: The household’s cars with their insurance, inspection and service dates, papers and a service log.
cap_view: See the household’s vehicles and their service log
cap_edit: Add and change vehicles and their service log
title: Vehicles
empty_hint: Add one to keep its insurance, inspection and service dates in one place.
not_found: This vehicle is not here any more.
error: That did not work. Please try again.
archive_hint: Archiving hides the vehicle and stops its reminders. Papers and history are kept.
field_name_hint: What the family calls it, e.g. “Family car”.
error_year: Enter the year with four digits
presets_hint: These are suggestions. Tick what applies, give the next date, and set how often it comes back.
preset_liability_insurance_hint: Cover for damage to others. Usually renewed every year.
preset_comprehensive_insurance_hint: Cover for your own car. Usually renewed every year.
preset_inspection_hint: Roadworthiness check. How often depends on where you live.
preset_tyres_hint: Check or change them. How often is up to you.
preset_vehicle_tax_hint: A fee or tax you pay to keep the vehicle on the road.
log_notes_hint: You can write the mileage here too.
discard_hint: What you typed here has not been saved.
